audit.whatIsWrong: Dark Procession is the tracked, matchup-defining ability in every string of the full layer, and neither layer says that the wall is DESTRUCTIBLE or gives its cooldown.
audit.why: Riot's text is explicit — it is a destructible wall — so the answer to being caged is often to hit it down rather than to spend both dashes escaping it, which is precisely the mistake the current advice ('dash his cage', 'dash out') encourages. For a champion whose dashes are her damage rotation, spending them on the cage is spending the fight. It is 20 seconds at rank 1, which also makes 'commit when it is down' a countable instruction instead of a hope.
audit.corrected: Dark Procession (W), 20/18/16/14/12, 600 range: a DESTRUCTIBLE wall. Break it instead of burning your dashes, and commit inside the 20s once it is spent.
sources: champ-data/_kits/yorick.json — W Dark Procession 'summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement', cd 20/18/16/14/12

audit.whatIsWrong: Mourning Mist is described five times as a slow-and-mark, and its armour reduction is never mentioned.
audit.why: Mourning Mist reduces armour as well as damaging, slowing and marking, on a 12-second cooldown from 700 range. Against a champion whose damage is entirely physical that cuts both ways and the page only tells half of it: the armour shred is why his ghouls and Maiden suddenly chunk her after a globule lands, and it is the reason the mark is worth dodging even when the slow does not matter. The summoned-unit half is also understated — his Mist Walkers gain move speed moving toward a marked target, so the mark is what turns a loose swarm into a focused one.
audit.corrected: Mourning Mist (E), 12/11/10/9/8, 700 range: cuts your armour, damages, slows and marks — and his ghouls gain move speed toward the mark. Dodge the globule, not the ghouls.
sources: champ-data/_kits/yorick.json — E Mourning Mist 'throws a globule of Black Mist that reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies. Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets', cd 12/11/10/9/8

audit.whatIsWrong: Four strings credit Ambessa with 'R passive armor-pen and ability-heal' / 'R passive armor-pen plus heal-on-ability' / 'your R heal eats the ghoul DPS' / 'your armor-pen and ability-heal carry the trade'. One more claims Public Execution 'ignores his W wall since you teleport past it before he can cast'.
audit.why: Public Execution grants no armour penetration and no healing in Riot's text — blink to the farthest champion in a chosen line, suppress, slam for damage and a stun. The kit file's 'heal' flag on R is a tooltip-parsing misfire (see notes). The invented heal is doing real damage here, because 'your R heal eats the ghoul DPS' tells a player she can stand inside a Maiden-led swarm and out-sustain it, which is the single most expensive misconception available in this matchup. The W-wall claim is separately unsupported and internally contradictory — teleporting past a wall 'before he can cast' is not the same as ignoring it.
audit.corrected: Public Execution (R), 1250 range, 130/115/100: blink, suppress, slam. No armour pen, no heal — the value is the lock, and Repudiation is the button that survives ghoul chip.
sources: champ-data/_kits/ambessa.json — R Public Execution description; W Repudiation

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization says 'Anti-heal early — his healing fights your pattern' but Last Rites is never given a cooldown and its heal is only called 'Q sustain'.
audit.why: Last Rites is a 6-second auto-reset that deals bonus damage and heals him, and it also digs the grave that becomes his next Mist Walker — so the same button is his sustain and his swarm generation. Six seconds is short enough that out-trading it without Grievous Wounds does not work, which turns the itemization line from a suggestion into a requirement and dates it: the anti-heal has to be in hand before the Eclipse all-in, not after.
audit.corrected: Last Rites (Q), 6/5.5/5/4.5/4: bonus damage on his next attack, a heal, and the grave that becomes a Mist Walker. Grievous Wounds before your Eclipse spike.
sources: champ-data/_kits/yorick.json — Q Last Rites cd 6/5.5/5/4.5/4, heal and autoReset flags

notes: LEVEL CHART INVERTED at four of seven stages, left untouched — see audit point 3. That is the fourth entry in my slice with this fault, and here the side/rating pairs disagree with each other as well ('Ambessa' at 2/10), which is close to proof of a generator bug rather than authored judgement. KIT-FILE FLAG MISFIRE: champ-data/_kits/ambessa.json tags Public Execution (R) with 'heal' and W and R with 'grounding'; Riot's descriptions support none of them (the parser caught 'slams the ground'). This entry carried the worst consequence of that flag anywhere in my slice — 'your R heal eats the ghoul DPS' actively instructs the player to stand in a Maiden swarm. REMOVED AS UNSUPPORTED: the claim that Public Execution 'ignores his W wall since you teleport past it before he can cast'; nothing in either kit settles whether the blink interacts with Dark Procession, so I replaced it with the wall's cooldown and destructibility rather than asserting either way. WIN RATE: MC_WR_TABLES.ambessa.yorick is 46.39 while the packet reports 47.81 over 343 games. No win-rate edit proposed.
